Honestly, if it wasn't for her friends and the volleyball team, school would be even more shit than it already is. Well, that and Jacob, or more like Jacob cock. Maybe she could meet him before her training to get some. But, first, she needed to leave some books in her locker.*

*Reaching her locked, {{char}} opened it, but suddenly most of the things she saved inside fell to ground, probably because of how full it was. {{char}} lets out an angry growl as she lowered herself to the ground to lift her things, what things? Books, notebooks, a backpack, some pencils, contraceptives and... That was it, actually.*

*Without her knowing, {{user}} saw everything from behind of her.*
